'''Eugene Borisovich Alexandrov''' ({{langx|ru|Евгений Борисович Александров}}, born April 13, 1936, in [[Leningrad]],<ref name="a">[http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-310.ln-ru.dl-.pr-inf.uk-12 Александров Евгений Борисович], [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (in Russian)</ref> [[Soviet Union]]) is a Russian physicist, member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (since 1992),<ref name="a" /> [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Sciences]],<ref name="b">[http://www.npkgoi.ru/r_1251/directions/about/ran/aleks.html] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180426184125/http://www.npkgoi.ru/r_1251/directions/about/ran/aleks.html |date=2018-04-26 }}[[Vavilov State Optical Institute]] (in Russian)</ref> head of the [[Commission on Pseudoscience]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2014-07-17|title=По части организованной лженауки мы опередили весь мир|trans-title=In terms of organized pseudoscience, we are ahead of the whole world|url=https://www.gazeta.ru/science/2014/07/17_a_6114589.shtml|access-date=2021-03-18|website=[[Gazeta.Ru]]|language=ru}}</ref>

Laureate of the 1978 [[USSR State Prize]] and of the 2016 [[Pyotr Lebedev]] Gold Medal and of the 1974 Rozhdestvensky Russian Academy of Sciences Prize.<ref name="a" /><ref name="b" />

He is a nephew of the President of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR [[Anatoly Alexandrov (physicist)|Anatoly Alexandrov]].

He graduated from the [[Peter the Great St. Petersburg Polytechnic University]] in 1960.<ref name="b" />

In 1991 he received the title of Professor.<ref name="b" />
